correctness.rationale: The bounded symmetric Lévy–Khintchine formula gives K(t)=V t² M(t)/2 and an exact scale supremum. Strict monotonicity of the even cosh remainder maximizes M(t) at each t under a variance-share constraint, with sharp constructive equality cases. Coefficient-ratio monotonicity uniquely determines the universal scalar optimizer. A two-range asymptotic proves Gaussian dilution. The claimed rational optimizer bracket and 1,625 supplementary rational checks reproduced from the included standalone script. Analytic steps cover infinite Lévy activity; finite checker results are not mistaken for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The true-variance optimal exponential-moment scale is a natural concentration invariant. The all-law constant 0.1742179596517... improves the standard L/3 bound and is attained only by an explicit two-endpoint Lévy law; the continuum of sharp small-jump-variance constraints quantifies structural improvement, identifies extremal jump profiles, and exhibits a nontrivial logarithmic transition as Gaussian noise dominates. These are class-wide sharp inequalities and boundary laws, not a one-parameter numerical recomputation.
